scope: Historical source 29ee nonfinal eight-cell state: observer-only radial-velocity control and exact-duplicate versus smoothly prescribed ten-cell transport. No thermal, statistical-equilibrium or new Parker solution is computed.

exact_duplicate.radius_override_scope: Parent radii retain the native 1/r rotation term. All other profile inputs duplicated; actual child thickness retained.

smooth_prescription.description: PCHIP in log radius of log temperature, log saved radial speed and composition coordinates; reconstruct density from the same mass flux; recompute continuum. Preserve unsplit cells. Child-center rotation changes with radius.

interpretation: Mere subdivision preserves transfer. A different positive, mass-conserving profile prescription materially changes the spectrum and the sign of its peak difference. It also changes integrated excited-state columns; this is not an equal-column grid test. This is a reason to resolve the atmospheric profile; it is not a bound on the converged ten-cell response or a missing-physics diagnosis.
follow_up: Keep numerical_resolution_review unknown. Validate the final current-source root, then requalify and solve the complete refined atmosphere. Retain the original <0.1 supplied-error convergence criterion. Interpolation and a single mesh pair cannot establish convergence.
publication: Scalar diagnostics, metadata and hashes only. Figures, raw states, spectral arrays and stellar data stay local.
